data.summary: Once this model has shot in your Shooting phase, pick one enemy unit, other than a TITANIC unit, that took at least one hit from those attacks. As long as this model remains on the battlefield, the chosen unit is suppressed until your next turn starts. Attacks made by models in a suppressed unit suffer -1 to their Hit roll.
